body.p: Craiova is situated near the east bank of the river Jiu in central Oltenia, at approximately equal distances from the Southern Carpathians (north) and the River Danube (south). The city is the largest in southwestern Romania and serves as the capital of Dolj County. It is a longstanding political and economic center in the region.

The city administers eight villages: Făcăi, Mofleni, Popoveni, Șimnicu de Jos, Cernele, Cernelele de Sus, Izvoru Rece, and Rovine. The last four were part of a separate commune called Cernele until 1996, when they were merged into the city.
